name: Forsaken Duties

angles.text: As an Undead, you know a breach in the border threatens Brill and the Forsaken's newly claimed Undercity.
As a member of the Horde, you know that guarding Tirisfal Glades against Scourge incursions preserves a reliable foothold in northern Lordaeron.

faq.answer: Magistrate Sevren in Brill asks you to bring back an updated report from the eastern Deathguard outpost.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Forsaken Duties?

faq.answer: Deathguard Linnea is stationed at the Deathguard waystation east of Brill. She watches the road and guards the approaches to the Plaguelands.
The Bulwark is a fortified border outpost between Tirisfal Glades and the Western Plaguelands. Its defenders keep the Scourge from overrunning Forsaken lands.

aliases: where are the scourge leaking through
faq.answer: Small Scourge groups sometimes slip past The Bulwark and gather around Balnir Farmstead, east of the waystation.
faq.q: Where are Scourge slipping past the border?

aliases: why does sevren need a report
faq.answer: Magistrate Sevren wants to keep the Scourge from gaining a strong foothold in Tirisfal Glades. The Deathguard must stay vigilant.
faq.q: Why does Magistrate Sevren want a status report?

faq.answer: From Brill, follow the road south, then turn east at the fork toward Tirisfal Glades' eastern reaches.
faq.q: How do you get to Deathguard Linnea's post?

sections.body: Magistrate Sevren watches over Brill and the countryside, keeping wary eyes on Tirisfal Glades' eastern border. The Scourge swarm across the Western Plaguelands, so sentries must report what they see. Sevren sends you south along the main road, then east, to bring back Deathguard Linnea's assessment.
sections.title: Vigilance on the Border

sections.body: Deathguard Linnea watches the frontier from an outpost beside the eastern road. Her report confirms Sevren's fears. The Bulwark holds the main Scourge host, but small groups sometimes slip past its defenses. Those strays gather around nearby Balnir Farmstead, threatening Tirisfal Glades.
sections.title: Reports from the Front

summary: Magistrate Sevren needs word from Tirisfal Glades' eastern border. He fears Scourge may slip past The Bulwark and threaten nearby settlements.
